highlights: OpenAI is strategically expanding its enterprise offerings with the launch of 'OpenAI Presence' for agent deployment and integrating health data into ChatGPT, significantly broadening its application utility.

Google is advancing its AI agent capabilities through new features in the Gemini API and enhancing developer tools with deeper app integration into Search, alongside new AI-powered video creation functionalities.

The Hugging Face ecosystem continues to drive technical innovation with advancements like 4-bit diffusion inference for models, a new robotics data recording system, and multi-cloud AI workload management solutions for greater efficiency.

agents.title: Introducing OpenAI Presence
agents.summary: OpenAI has launched Presence, an enterprise AI agent platform designed to help organizations deploy trusted voice and chat agents for customer and internal workflows, enhancing operational efficiency.

agents.title: Expanding Managed Agents in Gemini API
agents.summary: Google is enhancing Managed Agents in the Gemini API with new capabilities including background tasks and remote Multi-Cloud Platform (MCP) support, enabling developers to build more reliable and production-ready AI agents.

agents.title: How Cars24 scales conversations and builds faster with OpenAI
agents.summary: Cars24 leverages OpenAI-powered voice and chat agents to manage over 1 million monthly conversation minutes, recover lost leads, and implement agentic workflows across their teams, demonstrating scalable enterprise AI applications.

models.title: Bringing Nunchaku 4-bit Diffusion Inference to Diffusers
models.summary: Hugging Face has integrated Nunchaku 4-bit diffusion inference into Diffusers, providing significant improvements in efficiency and performance for deploying diffusion models.

models.title: New research shows how AMIE, our medical AI, could help manage health conditions.
models.summary: Google's research in Nature highlights how AMIE, a conversational AI system, demonstrates capabilities comparable to primary care physicians in managing complex health conditions, signaling significant potential for healthcare AI.

models.title: Safety and alignment in an era of long-horizon models
models.summary: OpenAI shares critical lessons from deploying long-running AI models, detailing new safety risks, observed failures, and improved safeguards implemented through iterative deployment, vital for responsible model development.

tools.title: Launching Health in ChatGPT
tools.summary: ChatGPT now allows eligible U.S. users to securely connect medical records and Apple Health, providing personalized insights and better understanding of their health data directly within the AI platform.

tools.title: Connect more of your apps to Search
tools.summary: Google is enabling users to securely link and interact with their preferred services directly within AI Mode in Search, expanding the utility and integration capabilities of AI-powered search.

tools.title: Run AI workloads on any cloud, store on Hugging Face: zero-egress storage with SkyPilot
tools.summary: Hugging Face introduces a solution with SkyPilot for running AI workloads on any cloud with zero-egress storage, streamlining multi-cloud deployments and data management for developers.

companies.title: OpenAI and Hugging Face partner to address security incident during model evaluation
companies.summary: OpenAI and Hugging Face collaborated to share early findings from a security incident during AI model evaluation, highlighting advanced cyber capabilities and crucial lessons for improving defense strategies.

companies.title: Building AI infrastructure with the Effingham County community
companies.summary: OpenAI announced Project Camellia in Effingham County, Georgia, committing to responsible energy use, community investment, job creation, and access to Codex, marking a significant infrastructure expansion.

companies.title: Advancing the next era of national science
companies.summary: OpenAI outlined its commitment to advancing American science by partnering with the U.S. Department of Energy and national labs, leveraging frontier AI to accelerate scientific discovery and innovation.

learning.title: Introducing the ChatGPT for small business program
learning.summary: OpenAI has launched a new program aimed at small businesses, providing entrepreneurs with resources to build AI skills, automate work, and foster growth using ChatGPT Work.

learning.title: What building Shippy taught us about building agents
learning.summary: This article from Hugging Face shares valuable lessons and insights derived from the process of building the 'Shippy' agent, offering practical guidance for developers engaged in agent development.

learning.title: Ask an AI expert: What exactly is the full stack?
learning.summary: A Google expert provides a comprehensive explanation of what it means to adopt a full-stack approach to AI, detailing why it has been foundational to Google's AI work and its implications for builders.
